items.reason: Fuel-market strike on 28 Aug killed at least 12, and Chad has sent more troops to the border. I expect repeated incidents, not one-offs.
So far the strikes are episodic. Sustained and recurrent across several localities within six months is a high bar.
The 21 Aug convoy strike was over 100 km inside Ennedi-Est, well beyond the border strip. The alert level is at its highest.
T0618 affiche toujours 40 %, fixé en juin. Les frappes d'août ont touché l'Ennedi-Est en profondeur : le déclencheur semble dépassé.
Aucune nouvelle attaque majeure côté tchadien fin septembre. La pression vient surtout des arrivées de réfugiés, pas d'attaques répétées.
No major new attack inside Chad in late September. Trimming slightly.
Others point to strikes far inside Ennedi-Est. That is more than border spillover, so moving up a little.
Je monte un peu : plusieurs signaux convergent.
Arrivals kept rising and the camps had little spare capacity.
Funding cuts plus insecurity in the camps: hard to see conditions improving.
Border tensions were high, but both sides kept stepping back from a prolonged conflict.
The military council seemed set to resist a handover, so more confrontation was probable.
Clashes were possible, but the main factions had reasons to avoid a wider fight.
